headline: Vercel's data shows that free-to-download AI models handled most of the traffic on its AI Gateway service in August, for the first time.
score_reason: Pool score kept: the numbers match the headline, but they cover one company's service and the month of August.
importance_line: Developers and the companies paying for AI are getting lower prices per token and a fast-changing list of leading models, but the figures come from one company's gateway and show that paid closed models still take most of the money.
summary: IT Brief Asia reports that Vercel's latest figures show open-weight models, whose settings anyone can download and run, handled 56% of the text pieces (called tokens) passing through its AI Gateway in August, up from 13% in April. The average price per token fell 23.2% in the month, but open-weight models made up only 14% of the money spent, with Anthropic's models taking 64%.
notes: Data is for August 2026; Vercel's publication date for the index is not stated in the article. Vercel's gateway is not the whole AI market.
